_doc: Detection-conservatism audit for Step 0 mode router. Each row declares an input shape and the mode Step 0 must route it to. All 14 existing convert fixtures MUST route to 'convert' (false-positive intake on a fixture is a P0 bug). All ambiguous/empty inputs route to 'intake'. See SKILL.md Step 0 decision tree.

_signal_legend.design_phrase: Step 0 rule 2 — merchant says 'I have a design'
_signal_legend.structured_paste: Step 0 rule 2 — pasted structured design output
_signal_legend.empty: Step 0 rule 3 — no design content; defaults to intake
_signal_legend.figma_url: Step 0 rule 3 — bare figma.com URL with no other design content

typical_inputs.notes: Bare skill activation with no message body. Today: undefined behavior. After v7.22: intake.

typical_inputs.example: I want to build a product page
Help me get started with a SureCart page
typical_inputs.notes: Same as above; intake opener will explain the path.

Rule 2 trips on the verbal claim even without paste. The opener asks the merchant to paste — this matches today's Step 1.0 behavior where it would error on missing input. Acceptable false-positive convert: merchant gets a 'paste your design' prompt, not garbage HTML.

_test_oracle_usage: This file is the test oracle for the Step 0 router. To verify: walk through each row in this file mentally (or via grep-based heuristic regex matchers in the future) and confirm Step 0's decision tree routes the input to expected_mode. Any disagreement is a Step 0 spec bug, not a fixture bug.
_contract: ANY row in 'fixtures' that routes to 'intake' is a P0 regression. Convert-mode flow MUST be preserved byte-for-byte (defense layer 3 in the plan).
